metadata.case_name: MUHAMMAD SADDIQ v. CHEUNG CHI KEUNG

plaintiff.occupation_before: Self-employed transportation business owner / LGV driver
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: Self-employed transportation business (LGV driver) with a full-time labourer

source: He suffers a whiplash injury to his neck as well as a sprained back.
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain, stiffness or tenderness only

source: He suffers a whiplash injury to his neck as well as a sprained back.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: Minimal spondylosis in his upper lumbar region (degenerative change)
source: The October 2007 MRI scan reveals that Mr. Saddiq has minimal spondylosis in his upper lumbar region.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: residual pain at his back and neck
He now feels pain when he bends his neck.
his lower back pain has prevented him from sitting down for longer than one hour.
range of movement (ROM) of his neck was still limited
minimal spondylosis in his upper lumbar region (MRI finding)

treatments_received: Hospitalisation at United Christian Hospital (admitted after accident, discharged 2005-04-08)
Physiotherapy (17 sessions: application of hot pack and exercises, April to July 2005)
Analgesics (Tuen Mun Hospital visits in early 2006)
treatments_future: Outpatient medical treatment and painkillers (judge assessed future reasonable treatment limited to outpatient care and painkillers)

losses.description: Not fit to lift heavy objects as a result of the back injury; has residual back pain limiting heavy lifting
Reduction in ability to operate his one-man transportation business without hiring a labourer, resulting in reduced profit
